title: Simple Variable Mass 3dof (Wind Axes)
text: Implement three-degrees-of-freedom equations of motion of simple variable mass with respect to wind axes, 6 inputs, 9 outputs, {Mass type} sets Mass type Simple; {Units} sets the input and output units Metric, {Axes} sets the body or wind, {Initial airspeed} sets the initial speed, {Initial flight path angle}, {Initial body rotation rate} sets the initial pitch rotation rate, {Initial incidence} sets the initial angle, {Initial position (x,z)} sets the initial location, {Initial mass}, {Empty mass} sets the mass of body when fuel tank is empty, {Full mass} sets the mass of body when fuel tank is full, {Empty inertia body axes} sets the inertia of body when fuel tank is empty, {Full inertia body axes} sets the body inertia when fuel tank is full, {Gravity Source}, {Acceleration due to gravity} sets the gravity source, {Include mass flow relative velocity} sets the mass flow relative velocity port, {Limit mass flow when mass is empty or full}, {Include inertial acceleration}, {Velocity: e.g., ’V’} sets the velocity state name, {Position: e.g., ’Xe’, ’Ze’} sets the position state name, {Body rotation rate: e.g., ’q’} sets the body rotation state name, {Flight path angle: e.g., ’gamma’} sets the flight path angle state name, {Incidence angle e.g., ’alpha’} sets the incidence angle state name and {Mass: e.g., ’mass’} sets the mass state name. Values come from the instance.
